meta.name: cpp-pro
meta.description: Writes, optimizes, and debugs C++ applications using modern C++20/23 features, template metaprogramming, and high-performance systems techniques. Use when building or refactoring C++ code requiring concepts, ranges, coroutines, SIMD optimization, or careful memory management — or when addressing performance bottlenecks, concurrency issues, and build system configuration with CMake.

howto.what: 使用现代C++20/23特性编写、优化和调试C++代码，遵循C++ Core Guidelines，使用concepts、RAII和智能指针，运行AddressSanitizer等检查，并产出头文件、实现、CMake配置和测试代码。
howto.when: 当构建或重构需要concepts、ranges、coroutines等特性的C++代码，或处理性能瓶颈、并发问题和CMake构建配置时触发。

howto.what_en: Writes, optimizes, and debugs C++ code with modern C++20/23 features, following C++ Core Guidelines, using concepts, RAII, smart pointers, and sanitizers, producing headers, implementations, CMake config, and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building or refactoring C++ code that uses concepts, ranges, coroutines, etc., or when addressing performance bottlenecks, concurrency issues, or CMake build configuration.
